dc78EQAAQBAJ.subtitle: A Practical Guide to Building AI-Powered Income After 50
dc78EQAAQBAJ.summary: The Second Wealth is a practical manual for experienced adults who want to turn accumulated judgment, knowledge, relationships, reputation, and pattern recognition into modern services, products, and systems supported by AI. It rejects instant-income promises and begins with runway, usable experience, the limits of generative AI, customer selection, privacy, and evidence. The book then moves through market listening, expensive-problem discovery, path selection, platform work, packaged services, assessments, digital assets, micro-tools, pricing, outreach, SOPs, automation, and ownership. Part Five uses hands-on laboratories for services, writing, local-business content, landing pages, AI opportunity assessments, digital products, content engines, and one-function tools. The final ninety-day plan moves from choosing a market and building one sample to customer conversations, paid pilots, delivery, documentation, pricing, a first SOP, and a low-risk automation. Twenty practical appendices provide readiness checks, scorecards, interview guides, offer cards, pricing sheets, outreach patterns, proposal and SOP templates, privacy checks, and a ninety-day dashboard.
dc78EQAAQBAJ.seo_description: A practical guide for adults over 50 to turn experience into AI-assisted services, products, and second-income systems through market testing, customer discovery, pricing, automation, and a 90-day evidence plan.
key_topics: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Notebook workflows
Platform work and AI evaluation jobs
learning: Identify the economic value hidden inside accumulated experience, judgment, relationships, and pattern recognition.
Build a realistic financial and time runway before choosing an AI-assisted income path.
Use generative AI as a checked apprentice rather than as an unquestioned authority.
Select one market and one expensive problem through interviews, evidence, and a path-selection matrix.
Turn expertise into packaged services, assessments, digital assets, content systems, or small decision tools.
Price and scope offers with clear boundaries, measurable outcomes, and respect for privacy and professional limits.
Test demand through samples, outreach, discovery calls, paid pilots, and explicit decision records.
Document repeatable delivery, automate only after proof, and build toward owned assets and a resilient second-income system.
Use the ninety-day plan and practical appendices to convert learning into external evidence rather than endless preparation.
dc78EQAAQBAJ.target_audience: For experienced professionals, retirees, career changers, consultants, managers, educators, and adults over 50 who want a realistic, evidence-based way to combine decades of experience with modern AI tools without relying on hype, guaranteed-income claims, or unnecessary technical complexity.

lc78EQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Guía práctica para generar ingresos con inteligencia artificial después de los 50
lc78EQAAQBAJ.summary: La segunda riqueza es una guía práctica para personas con experiencia que quieren convertir criterio, conocimientos, relaciones, reputación y reconocimiento de patrones en servicios, productos y sistemas apoyados por inteligencia artificial. El libro evita las promesas de dinero rápido y empieza por el margen real de tiempo y dinero, la experiencia utilizable, los límites de la IA generativa, la elección de mercado, la privacidad y la necesidad de trabajar con evidencia. Después desarrolla la escucha del mercado, los problemas caros, la selección de camino, el trabajo en plataformas, los servicios empaquetados, las evaluaciones para pequeñas empresas, los activos digitales, las microherramientas, el precio, la prospección, los procedimientos y la automatización posterior a la prueba. La parte de laboratorios obliga a producir objetos reales: una muestra de servicio, edición y ghostwriting, contenido para negocio local, una página de aterrizaje, una evaluación de oportunidades de IA, un producto digital, un motor de contenido o una herramienta de una sola función. El plan final de noventa días convierte el aprendizaje en entrevistas, muestras, pilotos, entregas, pruebas, procedimientos y decisiones basadas en evidencia. Los veinte apéndices reúnen hojas de trabajo, entrevistas, scorecards, ofertas, precios, mensajes, propuestas, controles de privacidad, SOP y paneles de seguimiento.
lc78EQAAQBAJ.seo_description: Guía práctica para mayores de 50 que quieren transformar experiencia en servicios, productos e ingresos asistidos por IA mediante validación de mercado, clientes, precios, automatización y un plan de 90 días.
key_topics: Ingresos con IA después de los 50
Problemas caros y validación de mercado
learning: Hacer visible el valor económico acumulado en experiencia, criterio, relaciones y reconocimiento de patrones.
Construir un margen realista de dinero, tiempo y energía antes de elegir un camino de ingresos.
Usar la IA generativa como aprendiz rápido que necesita revisión y límites.
Elegir un mercado y un problema valioso mediante entrevistas, señales y evidencia.
Convertir experiencia en servicios, evaluaciones, activos digitales, sistemas de contenido o pequeñas herramientas.
Definir alcance, precio, privacidad, aprobación humana y medidas de éxito antes de automatizar.
Validar la demanda con muestras, contactos, conversaciones y pilotos reales.
Documentar la entrega, crear procedimientos y automatizar solamente después de demostrar utilidad.
Aplicar el plan de noventa días y los apéndices para producir pruebas externas y decisiones claras.
lc78EQAAQBAJ.target_audience: Para profesionales con experiencia, personas en transición laboral, consultores, educadores, autónomos y mayores de 50 que desean combinar su experiencia con herramientas de IA de forma práctica, prudente y basada en evidencia.

mc78EQAAQBAJ.subtitle: 50 Yaşından Sonra Yapay Zekâ ile Gelir Oluşturmanın Uygulamalı Rehberi
mc78EQAAQBAJ.summary: İkinci Servet, yıllar içinde birikmiş muhakeme, bilgi, ilişki, itibar ve örüntü tanıma becerisini modern yapay zekâ araçlarıyla hizmete, ürüne ve sisteme dönüştürmek isteyen deneyimli yetişkinler için uygulamalı bir rehberdir. Kitap hızlı zenginlik vaadi sunmaz; önce zaman ve para pistini, kullanılabilir deneyimi, üretken yapay zekânın sınırlarını, pazar seçimini, mahremiyeti ve kanıt disiplinini kurar. Ardından pahalı sorunları bulma, müşteriyle konuşma, yol seçimi, platform işi, paketli hizmet, işletme değerlendirmesi, dijital varlık, mikro araç, fiyatlandırma, ilk yirmi kapı, keşif görüşmeleri, SOP, kanıttan sonra otomasyon ve sahip olunan varlıklara geçiş üzerinde ilerler. Beşinci bölümde hizmet, yazı ve editörlük, yerel işletme içeriği, açılış sayfası, AI fırsat değerlendirmesi, dijital ürün, içerik motoru ve tek işlevli araç laboratuvarları vardır. Son doksan günlük plan seçimden örnek üretmeye, pazara çıkmaya, ilk teslimata, süreci belgelemeye ve tekrar edilebilir bir gelir sistemine doğru ilerler. Uygulama ekleri; hazırlık testleri, deneyim envanteri, sorun puan kartı, müşteri görüşmesi, teklif kartı, fiyatlandırma, mesaj örnekleri, teklif ve SOP şablonları, mahremiyet kontrolü ve doksan günlük panel sağlar.
mc78EQAAQBAJ.seo_description: 50 yaşından sonra deneyimi yapay zekâ destekli hizmet, ürün ve ikinci gelir sistemine dönüştürmek için pazar doğrulama, müşteri görüşmeleri, fiyatlandırma, otomasyon ve 90 günlük uygulama rehberi.
learning: Deneyim, muhakeme, ilişki ve örüntü tanıma içinde saklı ekonomik değeri görünür kılmak.
Bir gelir yolunu seçmeden önce gerçekçi zaman, para ve enerji pistini hesaplamak.
Üretken yapay zekâyı denetlenmesi gereken hızlı bir çırak gibi kullanmak.
Müşteri görüşmeleri, sinyaller ve kanıtla bir pazar ve değerli sorun seçmek.
Deneyimi paketli hizmete, değerlendirmeye, dijital varlığa, içerik sistemine veya küçük araca dönüştürmek.
Fiyat, kapsam, mahremiyet, insan onayı ve başarı ölçüsünü otomasyondan önce tanımlamak.
Örnekler, erişim mesajları, keşif görüşmeleri ve pilotlarla gerçek talebi test etmek.
Tekrarlanabilir teslimi belgelemek ve yalnız kanıtlandıktan sonra düşük riskli otomasyon kurmak.
Doksan günlük plan ve uygulama ekleriyle öğrenmeyi dış dünyada ölçülebilir kanıta çevirmek.
mc78EQAAQBAJ.target_audience: Deneyimli profesyoneller, emekliler, kariyer değiştirenler, danışmanlar, yöneticiler, eğitmenler ve 50 yaş üstünde yılların deneyimini yapay zekâ araçlarıyla gerçekçi ve kanıta dayalı bir ikinci gelir sistemine dönüştürmek isteyen okurlar için.

nnUIEgAAQBAJ.subtitle: The Frontier Agent Playbook: A Practical Operating Manual for Long-Horizon AI Agents, Coding, Research, Knowledge Work, Tools, Verification, Safety, and Production Systems
nnUIEgAAQBAJ.summary: Claude Fable 5.1 & Mythos 5.1: The Frontier Agent Playbook treats frontier models as components inside an engineered operating system rather than as magical chatbots. The book begins with the shift from short conversations to long-horizon delegated work and explains when Fable 5.1 is justified, how Mythos 5.1 changes the access and safeguard boundary, and why routing should follow task shape, evidence, cost, latency, permissions, and failure risk rather than model prestige. It develops executable specifications, definitions of done, authority matrices, effort calibration, model routing, context hierarchies, compaction, explicit state, bounded tools, least privilege, read-back verification, parallel work, long-running state machines, retries, replanning, stop conditions, multi-agent handoffs, and coordination budgets. Applied chapters cover repository-level coding, debugging, PRD-to-product execution, deep research, PDFs and charts, spreadsheets, slides, computer use, and scientific workflows. Production chapters address caching, batching, cost per completed task, observability, evaluation, safeguards, approvals, and an independent verifier. The closing reference architecture separates intake, task specification, routing, context, tools, runtime, state, artifact storage, permissions, verification, observability, safeguards, evaluation, and delivery, followed by a thirty-day production roadmap and operational scorecards.
nnUIEgAAQBAJ.seo_description: A practical engineering manual for Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 covering long-horizon agents, model routing, context, tools, verification, multi-agent systems, coding, research, safety, economics, observability, and production architecture.
learning: Decide when a frontier model is justified instead of using the most capable model by default.
Distinguish model capability from the agent harness, runtime, access policy, and safeguard configuration that shape observed behavior.
Turn a vague task into an executable work contract with outcome, boundaries, authority, evidence, and escalation paths.
Manage very large context windows with source hierarchy, retrieval timing, compaction, and explicit durable state.
Design tools with strict schemas, least privilege, failure semantics, identifiers, and independent read-back verification.
Build long-horizon execution around milestones, artifacts, state machines, bounded retries, recovery, and legitimate stop conditions.
Use multi-agent structures only when independence, specialization, or parallelism justifies their coordination cost.
Apply the framework to codebases, research, documents, spreadsheets, slides, computer use, and scientific work.
Measure completed-work economics with cache, batch, tool loops, retries, latency, human repair, and strict success rather than raw token price alone.
Separate the builder's claim of completion from an independent verifier and production evaluation layer.
nnUIEgAAQBAJ.target_audience: For AI engineers, software developers, agent builders, technical product leaders, researchers, automation architects, and advanced Claude users who need to design long-running, tool-using systems that are observable, verifiable, permission-aware, cost-conscious, and safe enough for production work.
